text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Oh no! I was supposed to be
drilling for the
upcoming quiz!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Time to get back to it! All I've
gotta do is
copy down all the basic
formulas! Ten notebooks
worth...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory is enthusiastic about
getting her grades up. Unfortunately, it
seems like the
constant studying has left
her exhausted.
